bagPolicy.summary: The Eccles Theater prohibits bags and backpacks over 12 × 12 × 6 inches; there are no lockers or bag check for oversize bags. Medical equipment and diaper bags are exceptions.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Paid downtown garages and metered street spaces serve the theater; the City Center TRAX station is nearby. Weekday street meters operate 8 a.m.–8 p.m. with a two-hour limit.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The county visitor guide covers transit and parking but does not designate a rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concessions open before shows and during intermission, offering soft drinks, candy, baked goods and beer. Eccles allows concession-purchased food in the auditorium, and water is allowed.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The theater offers wheelchair seating, curbside assistance and free assisted-listening devices at the lower-lobby coat check; contact ArtTix for accommodation requests.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The county venue and visitor pages do not state a general re-entry rule for Eccles Theater performances.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The Salt Lake County visitor page names ArtTix for tickets but does not specify a Will Call pickup method.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The official county visitor guidance does not publish a universal Eccles concert door time.
